passes.reason: run beyond the per-step floor (no group carries a `[risk: …]` tag, so the on-risk rows are not owed), for continuity with step 2's record and because this group introduces the application's entire interactive surface. Declared surfaces handed over: none — `tasks.md`'s preamble declares as a deliberate claim that this part has no auth, writes no data, spawns no process, moves no money, handles no secret and changes no file mode, and Groups 3-4's rationales name their damage as component-tree relocation and a nav item silently losing its meaning. passes.name: silent-failure-hunter
passes.reason: run beyond the per-step floor: both rejected defects were silent-failure shapes — `outline-none` making three `focus-visible:` utilities dead code that read as compliance, and a hit area that swallows clicks on neighbouring text invisibly — so the invocation's own brief is a silent-failure brief. Nothing found: no `catch` anywhere in the diff, no `.catch(() => {})`, no floating promise, no success-shaped error return. The three guarded fallbacks (`matchMedia` absent, `requestAnimationFrame` absent, a `data-theme` outside the vocabulary) each carry a comment stating the intent and each falls to the documented R24 default rather than to silence; `Progress`'s `value ?? 0` is the one dangerous-fallback shape and the human has judged it acceptable. Both former defects now have a test that goes red when the shape returns, verified by mutant
